data.name: Quillan
data.gender_notes: Quillan is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Quillan is recorded in name-lists as “Young warrior”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Quillan expresses “Young warrior”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Quillan total 32, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: קוילן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: One who is like a young wolf, possibly a warrior or leader. This name is not found in the Bible.

in_greek.name: Κοιλλάν
in_greek.long_meaning: Originally meant ‘interior,’ but later came to mean ‘wailing, lamentation, or inner turmoil.’ This name is not found in the Bible.

in_latin.name: Quillanus
in_latin.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word ‘quillus,’ meaning ‘quill, feather.’ This name is not found in the Bible.
